The goal of the quest is to free spirits from Leech Tunnels, and then lead those spirits to the entrance.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Free the other Orrian spirits from the [[Leech Tunnels]]. You have rescued [0...3] of 3 spirits. 
* Lead [[Orrian Spirit Gildran]] to the entrance of the Leech Tunnels. 
* Lead [[Orrian Spirit Minos]] to the entrance of the Leech Tunnels. 
* Lead [[Orrian Spirit Kandril]] to the entrance of the Leech Tunnels. 
* See [[Wandering Soul]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* 100 [[Lightbringer Promotion Points]]
* [[Inscribed Secret]]

== Walkthrough ==
Following on from the previous quest, head to each of the three markers to find different groups of stationary awaiting torment creatures. Orrian Spirit Minos also has some awaiting titans. The Orrian spirits cannot be attacked and so you don't need to worry about them.

After saving all three spirits, head to where you picked up the previous quest - the resurrection shrine at the entrance to the Leech Tunnels.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wandering Soul
:''"<Character name>! I remember now that I was not alone when I entered the [[Leech Tunnels]]. Some of my fellow [[Orr]]ians suffered the same fate as I. They must remain somewhere inside the tunnels, losing their essence to the Gluttons with each passing moment. Save them from their dismal fate!"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Your friends won't forget this rescue!
|decline = I'm no glutton for punishment... or rescue missions.

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Orrian Spirit Minos:''' ''"Help! Kill these demons before they consume me!"''
:'''Orrian Spirit Gildran:''' ''"Slay these demons before they feast on my soul!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Wandering Soul
:''"You have shown much compassion to a few forgotten spirits. May your journey through this tormented realm be free of danger, though in all honesty I suspect you'll face challenges ahead. As for us, we seek the spirit of the evil Vizier to exact our long-awaited revenge."''

==Notes==
*As the spirits are capable of [[body block]]ing characters, there may be a little trouble moving through the narrow Leech Tunnels.
